_approach: Tom cascade build: high, mid and low toms trade a run that lengthens each beat across two bars, thickening from single hits to a full 16th cascade in the final beat; the kick holds steady 4/4 underneath (techno keeps the floor moving through its builds), and a crash plus a full-velocity low-tom run mark the handoff into the drop. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
